name: domain-guardian
description: Keeps AI coding agents grounded in project-specific business rules, user flows, and operational context.

interface.longDescription: Domain Guardian gives Codex a structured project memory for business models, domain rules, critical user flows, operational context, and code ownership boundaries. It guides agents to ask onboarding questions, create a domain impact brief before edits, and review diffs against the rules behind the code.
defaultPrompt: Use Domain Guardian before changing domain-sensitive code.
Onboard this project with Domain Guardian.
Review this diff with Domain Guardian.
